### Top Vitamin C Serums by Category

- **Best Overall:** [SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:7126775344274584588,gpcid:519387821950016223,headlineOfferDocid:7144137897676426309,catalogid:3983464506489418456,productDocid:4814364787053345533,rds:PC_1105847761893367068%7CPROD_PC_1105847761893367068&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiS-Ln-3oKYAxUihP0HHcXWAkYQxa4PeggIAggBCBEQAw) — Widely considered the gold standard by dermatologists; features 15% L-ascorbic acid, 1% vitamin E, and ferulic acid for maximum environmental protection and brightening (approx. $185).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-vitamin-c-serums/)[[2]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/best-vitamin-c-serum/)
- **Best Value / Budget Pick:** [Timeless Skin Care 20% C + E Ferulic Acid Serum](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462795033977703,imageDocid:7782077611606204783,gpcid:1353242067132680949,headlineOfferDocid:681063273554232928,catalogid:194794783255610028,productDocid:15771007346069020899,rds:PC_1353242067132680949%7CPROD_PC_1353242067132680949&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiS-Ln-3oKYAxUihP0HHcXWAkYQxa4PeggIAggBCBEQCQ) — A cult-favorite, lightweight formula delivering high potency at a fraction of the luxury price (approx. $26).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-vitamin-c-serums/)
- **Best for Sensitive Skin:** [Naturium Vitamin C Complex Serum](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462862296848781,imageDocid:18206816240993787028,gpcid:356220226857929446,headlineOfferDocid:9752384815994139457,catalogid:17793733170008031080,productDocid:2124797409506001282,rds:PC_356220226857929446%7CPROD_PC_356220226857929446&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiS-Ln-3oKYAxUihP0HHcXWAkYQxa4PeggIAggBCBEQDw) — Uses a gentler sodium ascorbyl phosphate derivative to brighten without stinging or irritation (approx. $15).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-vitamin-c-serums/)
- **Best for Dry Skin:** [Sunday Riley C.E.O. 15% Vitamin C Brightening Serum](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462852880521310,imageDocid:10029461179887318900,gpcid:1235705681827983262,headlineOfferDocid:6482507799188368933,catalogid:6783554837016569173,productDocid:6408183094707758240,rds:PC_1235705681827983262%7CPROD_PC_1235705681827983262&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiS-Ln-3oKYAxUihP0HHcXWAkYQxa4PeggIAggBCBEQFQ) — Formulated with oil-soluble THD ascorbate, making it deeply hydrating and nourishing for dry or mature barriers (approx. $85).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-vitamin-c-serums/)
- **Best Drugstore Pick:** [Mad Hippie Vitamin C Serum](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462563008867368,imageDocid:17514936553266472739,gpcid:1750157999783515,headlineOfferDocid:6602411431741876949,catalogid:3804743810886834336,productDocid:5276069743420341010,rds:PC_2177228048142109061%7CPROD_PC_2177228048142109061&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiS-Ln-3oKYAxUihP0HHcXWAkYQxa4PeggIAggBCBEQGw) — A stable, plant-infused, non-irritating sodium ascorbyl phosphate blend easily found at major retailers (approx. $30).[[1]](https://www.forbes.com/sites/forbes-personal-shopper/article/best-vitamin-c-serum/)
- **Best for Oily & Acne-Prone Skin:** [La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Serum](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462503364294657,imageDocid:17448405711147608637,gpcid:15105938738934844995,headlineOfferDocid:12280238519963889669,catalogid:5883854304966577232,productDocid:18389107366099720374,rds:PC_15105938738934844995%7CPROD_PC_15105938738934844995&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiS-Ln-3oKYAxUihP0HHcXWAkYQxa4PeggIAggBCBEQIQ) — Combines pure ascorbic acid with salicylic acid to help refine pores and smooth texture (approx. $38).[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-vitamin-c-serums/)

### Quick Shopping Guide: What to Look For

1. **The Form of Vitamin C:** 
	- **L-ascorbic acid:** The most potent and clinically researched pure form, best for normal-to-oily skin types.
	- **THD Ascorbate or Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate:** Gentler, oil-soluble or derivative forms that are far less likely to irritate sensitive or dry skin.
2. **Supporting Antioxidants:** Look for formulas that include **ferulic acid** and **vitamin E** , which stabilize the vitamin C and double its effectiveness against free radicals.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-vitamin-c-serums/)
3. **Packaging:** Vitamin C oxidizes and degrades when exposed to light and air. Always choose **opaque, airless pump bottles** rather than clear droppers.

- What is your main **skin goal** (fading dark spots, anti-aging, or general glow)?
- What is your **budget range**?
